set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user rta.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class super-user.explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication encrypted-password @%@%ED.explanation: The command sets an encrypted password for user authentication, where `[parameter2]` specifies the encrypted password string to be used for secure access.

ppp-options chap default.explanation: The command `ppp-options chap [parameter2]` configures CHAP (Challenge Handshake Authentication Protocol) authentication for PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) connections in Junos.

parameters.name: chap-option
parameters.explanation: PPP CAP authentication options, such as default.

ppp-options chap secret @%@%j]v~7%f[#S'W.explanation: The command configures a CHAP secret for PPP authentication, where `[parameter2]` specifies the password used for CHAP challenge-response.

set access profile default1.explanation: This command fragment sets an access profile in Junos, defining a named profile (parameter1) to configure security policies, authentication, or authorization settings for network access.

parameters.name: profile-name
parameters.explanation: Accesses the name of the profile.

authentication-order password.explanation: Configures the authentication order for access to the profile.

client user rta.explanation: Configure the client who accesses the profile.
